The '''Brentaal Spacefarers League''' was a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] organization based on [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] circa [[3700 BBY/Legends|3700 BBY]]. [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]] took an apprenticeship in the league despite the disapproval of her parents [[Olun Kallea|Olun]] and [[Henne Kallea]].
